 Order

The present petition is filed under section 439(2) Cr.P.C. read with section 482 Cr.P.C. for cancellation of anticipatory bail granted to the respondent no.2 vide order dated 08.11.2023 passed by the court of Sh. Jagmohan Singh, ASJ (Special FTC), North West, Rohini Courts, Delhi in bail application bearing no.2253/2023 arising out of FIR bearing no.0418/2023 registered under sections 323/376 IPC at P.S. Kanjhawala.

sentences.text: 2. The counsel for the petitioner on instructions seeks permission to withdraw the present petition.
3. The present petition is dismissed as withdrawn.
4. The trial of the case arising out of present FIR shall not be influenced in any manner by the observation made in the order dated 08.11.2023.
DR. SUDHIR KUMAR JAIN, J DECEMBER 15, 2023/
